# Innector

> Affordable managed IT services and remote software development for SMBs, startups, and enterprises in the USA, Canada, Australia, UAE (Dubai), and Qatar. Web development, mobile apps, corporate branding, custom software (including ERP), IT infrastructure and cloud migration, digital marketing, AI-powered chatbots, business process automation, and custom AI development - with a 15-day free trial on managed IT services.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.innector.net/): Global IT solutions provider serving SMBs in USA, Canada, Australia, Dubai & Qatar with remote IT support, managed services, and digital solutions.
- [About](https://www.innector.net/about): Background on Innector as an IT partner offering remote support and managed services across 5 markets.
- [Services](https://www.innector.net/services): 9 core services - web development, mobile apps, corporate branding, custom software (including ERP), IT infrastructure & cloud migration, digital marketing, AI-powered chatbots, business process automation, and custom AI development.
- [Managed IT Services](https://www.innector.net/managed-it-services): All-in-one managed IT for $999/month, with a 15-day free trial.
- [Blog](https://www.innector.net/blog): Plain-language guides on hiring a freelancer, a company, or an IT partner.
- [Contact](https://www.innector.net/contact): Get in touch about a project or start a free trial.

- [Try Before You Hire: Why a 15-Day Trial Beats a Sales Pitch](https://www.innector.net/blog/try-before-you-hire): Why testing a company before committing is the smartest way to hire, and how Innector's 15-day free trial works.
- [The True Cost of a Freelancer vs. a Company (With Real Numbers)](https://www.innector.net/blog/true-cost-freelancer-vs-company): Real hourly-rate and project-cost numbers for freelancers vs. companies.

- [Who Should Build Your Project? A Practical Guide](https://www.innector.net/blog/who-should-build-your-project): A quick decision guide to freelancer vs. company vs. dedicated team vs. an ongoing partner.
- [Freelancer vs. Company: How to Choose the Right Partner for Your Project](https://www.innector.net/blog/freelancer-vs-company): The pillar guide comparing freelancers, companies, and dedicated teams for any project.
- [How to Outsource Your Project to a Remote IT Company (Without the Guesswork)](https://www.innector.net/blog/outsourcing-remote-it-company): What outsourcing actually means and whether the common worries about it are real.
